# Test fixtures

## pre_n1_release.db

A **genuine pre-N1 database**, produced by the actual release code —
not synthesized:

- Generated by `gen_pre_n1_fixture.py` (repo root) against a `git
  worktree` checkout of merge commit `149690a` (post-#120 main, the
  last pre-N1 build). The worktree's `app.*` modules run the
  migrations, so the schema is whatever the release created.
- Stamped `alembic_version = '0012_c5a'`; `timeline_clips` has the
  pre-N1 column set (no `track_id`, no `start_frames`).
- Rows were inserted through the release's own ORM models
  (`Project → Timeline → AssetFile → Asset → AssetVersion →
  TimelineClip`), so every FK/default is exactly what the release
  wrote — including `timeline_clips.position` sequence ordering and
  the version/SHA-256 pins.
- Contents: one project "Pre-N1 Film", timeline "Launch Cut"
  (revision 2, 24/1), two sequential clips: 48f@24/1 then
  60f@30000/1001 (the mixed-rate boundary that exercises
  ceil-packing).

Used by `test_n1a_tracks.py::test_migration_genuine_pre_n1_release_db`.
Regenerate only if the pre-N1 schema itself changes meaningfully —
the point of the fixture is that it froze the *old* schema.

## pre_n3_release.db + pre_n3_media/

A **genuine pre-N3 database**, produced by the actual release code —
not synthesized:

- Generated by `gen_pre_n3_fixture.py` against a `git worktree`
  checkout of merge commit `663cb5d` (post-N2-F main, the last
  pre-N3 build). The worktree's `app.*` modules ran the migrations,
  so the schema is whatever the release created.
- Stamped `alembic_version = '0018_n2f'`; `timeline_tracks` lacks the
  `automation_json`/`automation_interp` columns added by `0019_n3a`.
- Contents: project "Pre-N3 Feature" — character `Ada` (rev 3),
  world, location, scene "Dock Arrival" + 3 shots + cast, timeline
  "Feature Cut" @30000/1001 (revision 12) with V1 + A1(−3 dB) +
  A2(−9 dB) lanes; clips carry gain/fades and step+linear automation;
  a 24f equal-power crossfade; undo stack [{rev 11},{rev 12}] backed
  by real `entity_revisions` snapshots written through the release's
  own `timeline_snapshot`.
- `pre_n3_media/` holds the four sha-pinned WAV sources (dia/mus/
  sfx/vo) — the acceptance driver stages them into CAS blobs so the
  migrated project's `ready` assets resolve.

Used by `scripts/cdp-n3d-acceptance.cjs` step 11 (D7 existing-project
regression: migrate 0018→0019 on the installed app and verify bibles,
shots, lanes, automation, crossfade, undo/redo, backup, restart).
Regenerate only if the pre-N3 schema itself changes meaningfully —
the point of the fixture is that it froze the *old* schema.
